info.title: Catering preparation, consumables and templates
info.description: Event writes use the event version, including equipment demand. Catalog/template writes use their own version. Quantities are exact decimal strings in responses. Preparation does not reserve stock. See preparation.md for state and permission rules.

Quantity.description: Exact amount 0..1000000.000. Send integers or decimal strings, never JSON floats. Discrete units require whole amounts.
